regional_summary_6h.headline: Iran announces restricted zone near Strait of Hormuz, raising maritime tension.
bullets: Iran to announce a restricted zone outside the Strait of Hormuz, limiting vessel movement in the area.
The restricted zone could disrupt commercial shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, increasing operational risk for maritime operators.
Iranian border-security forces may boost patrols along the southern coastline in response to the new restrictions.
regional_summary_6h.watch: Monitor for further Iranian announcements and any surge in naval activity near the Strait of Hormuz.
